note: TAF4-related neurodevelopmental disorder (OMIM #620450) consistently presents with intellectual disability/developmental delay and prominent speech/language involvement across described cohorts.

evidence.text: A cohort of eight individuals carrying de novo putative loss-of-function variants in TAF4 exhibited neurodevelopmental disorder phenotypes, with intellectual disability, abnormal behavior, and facial dysmorphisms as common features.

source.title: De novo putative loss‐of‐function variants in TAF4 are associated with a neuro‐developmental disorder
source.quote: We here present a cohort of eight individuals, each carrying de novo putative loss-of-function (pLoF) variants in TAF4 and expressing phenotypes consistent with a neuro-developmental disorder (NDD). Common features include intellectual disability, abnormal behavior, and facial dysmorphisms.

evidence.text: Intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 73 is described as a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by intellectual disability ranging from mild to severe, developmental delay, and speech delay.

source.title: Intellectual Developmental Disorder, Autosomal Dominant 73
source.quote: An autosomal dominant disorder characterized by intellectual disability ranging from mild to severe, developmental delay, speech delay, behavioral abnormalities
